# scylladbcloud_notification_emails (Resource)

The email addresses that receive the account's notifications. One per account; destroying it keeps the addresses, since the account must always have at least one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Send the account's notifications to two addresses.
resource "scylladbcloud_notification_emails" "example" {
	emails = ["ops@example.com", "oncall@example.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `emails` (Set of String) Email addresses; at least one.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by account ID.
terraform import scylladbcloud_notification_emails.example 42
```
